case_title: VANESSA THOMAS VS. YEE G KONG et al

docket_entries.description: PERSONAL INJURY/PROPERTY DAMAGE - VEHICLE RELATED, COMPLAINT FILED BY PLAINTIFF THOMAS, VANESSA AS TO DEFENDANT KONG, YEE G DOES 1 TO 10 SUMMONS ISSUED, JUDICIAL COUNCIL CIVIL CASE COVER SHEET FILED STATUS CONFERENCE SCHEDULED FOR          SEP-27-2002 PROOF OF SERVICE DUE ON                  JUL-29-2002 STATUS CONFERENCE STATEMENT DUE ON       AUG-29-2002
ADDED TO PROOF OF SERVICE ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE CALENDAR HEARING SET FOR AUG-27-2002 AT 09:00 AM IN DEPT 212
MINI-MINUTES FOR AUG-27-2002 9:00 AM FOR DEPT 212
SANCTIONS OF $200.00 AGAINST VANESSA THOMAS FOR FAILURE TO APPEAR AT THE ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE HEARING ON: AUG-27-2002 PAYABLE ON OR BEFORE SEP-12-2002. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE SET FOR NOV-06-2002 IN DEPARTMENT 212 AT 1:30 PM FOR FAILURE TO FILE PROOF OF SERVICE ON DEFENDANT(S) AND OBTAIN ANSWER(S), OR ENTER DEFAULT(S). THE SEP-27-2002 CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE IS OFF CALENDAR. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.
MINI-MINUTES FOR NOV-06-2002 1:30 PM FOR DEPT 212

SANCTIONS ORDERED IN THE AMOUNT OF $250.00 AGAINST VANESSA THOMAS FOR FAILURE TO APPEAR AT THE ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE HEARING ON: NOV-06-2002, PAYABLE ON OR BEFORE NOV-21-2002. PROCEEDINGS REPORTED BY: BRENDA FIELDS (212) NOTICE SENT BY COURT.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE SET FOR NOV-06-2002 CONTINUED TO JAN-22-2003 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 212 FOR FAILURE TO FILE PROOF OF SERVICE ON DEFENDANT(S) AND OBTAIN ANSWER(S), OR ENTER DEFAULT(S). NOTICE SENT BY COURT.
MINI-MINUTES FOR JAN-22-2003 1:30 PM FOR DEPT 212

CASE DISMISSED BY COURT AT ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE HEARING JAN-22-2003 AT 1:30PM. THE COURT FINDS THAT A LESS SEVERE SANCTION WOULD NOT BE EFFECTIVE IN LIGHT OF THE HISTORY OF FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH THE COURT'S ORDERS AND RULES NOTICE SENT BY COURT. PROCEEDINGS REPORTED BY PATRICIA VAN STEENBERGE. (212)
